integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 无轮廓线2D实验动画， a single fixed shot with the camera completely locked for the full 15 seconds. The entire frame is composed of pure flat color planes with no outline, no interior linework, no brush texture, and no gradient shading — every form exists only through the cutting, occlusion and displacement of color blocks. Space is crushed into a near-absolute flat plane, a hybrid of an urban section-cut diagram and a geometric overhead plan, laid out as color units on one graphic sheet. The palette is strictly deep indigo-violet, grey-white, soft pink and black, with only a trace of cold grey-blue as transition. At center, a rigorously geometric open plaza is assembled from large grey-white rectangles and angled trapezoid planes; around it, buildings made of slender vertical modules in deep grey, dark purple and cold white stand motionless like standardized urban components. Crowds are not people but tiny rectangles and short bars of color, slowly moving or pausing in pairs and small clusters, extremely small in scale. In the black underground zone across the lower frame, a vast soft-pink curved plane faintly emerges, pressing up against the strata toward the surface; its boundary with the black region remains a pure flat color cut — 不使用模糊或线条， no blur, no line. From around the fourth second, the pink mass keeps rising while the composition stays perfectly flat: a slightly raised long strip suggests a forehead, a downward light/dark shift suggests a nose bridge, and recessed junctions of soft pink against deep dark establish eye sockets — no linework, no realistic features, only tidy block boundaries and flat volume interlock. Plaza paving blocks shift minutely, some sliding outward, some slightly lifted; the base color blocks of several adjacent buildings tilt slightly. The tiny crowd blocks stop, disperse and gather at the edges of the open space in a silent onlooker-like order. From around the ninth second, the face rises higher until it occupies the geometric center of the urban void, and one closed giant eye is fully revealed at ground level: the eyelid is a single deep flat shadow band pressed across a curved soft-pink plane forming the abstract closed eye-slit, surrounded by large regularly divided soft-pink and dark-purple blocks, reading simultaneously as a face fragment, a building cross-section and a colossal urban installation. The grey-white ground splits outward into neat but dislocated slabs like a pried-apart hard thin plate; surrounding buildings lean mildly, vertical order broken yet calm, minimal and graphic. The crowd blocks arrange in a near-ritual incomplete ring, every one facing the closed giant eye, not a single block moving. In the final instant, at the center of the closed eyelid occurs one extremely slight contraction while the low frequency in the black underground layer dips once in sync; the frame holds on the state of 它马上要睁开，却仍未睁开 — about to open, yet still unopened. 无对白 throughout.

overall_soundscape: A continuous deep electronic drone sustain runs underneath, layered with subtle underground tremor, distant urban electrical hum and occasional structural scraping. As the pink mass rises, the drone thickens with faint structural friction, like the city surface contacting an enormous flat body below. In the final phase the sound compresses to a single sustained low drone, as if the whole city is holding its breath, with one synchronized low-frequency dip at the final eyelid contraction.
